clues: This town is the chief and most big town of its region in the north of its land. It is the seventh most peopled town in the land.
Most rain falls in spring and in the fall. Snow comes at times from late fall to the start of spring.
The most old school of high learning in the world that still runs was set up here in 1088.
Long roofed walks line this town for miles and miles. In 2021 the world named them a prize site of the past.
In 2022 a big news sheet named this town the best town in its land for the good life.
